00 Meta
June 16, 2022
Matt Love
Director
Love Frankie
Hi Matt,
Thank you for the conversation we had during our meeting in Singapore on the 23'd of April.
As we have discussed for the last couple of months, it was great to discuss possibility of
partnership with Love Frankie and its partners on running University Challenge We Think
Digital (known locally as Asah Digital) trainings on internet safety and digital literacy across
several universities in Indonesia. Below please find our minutes of conversation that we
will follow up respectively, subject to future agreements where necessary, due diligence
and also further internal approval from our end.
1. Together we will explore the possibility to support for University Challenge
Indonesia - We Think Digital with the program beginning in July 2022 - July 2023
implementation period with the following details:
• Plan to access to the latest, updated version of the WTD digital literacy materials,
total of 6 modules, developed, localized and translated together with local experts
in H1 2022, in the form of presentations and printable handouts from Program
Manager from Meta to be used during the duration of the program;
• Plan to engage Meta's current trainers, to provide trainings over the course of the
year for the duration of program;
• We may also feature the materials of the program on our WTD Website
at [link omitted] omitted]/, which will be uploaded by Meta's vendors;
• We estimate the total value of our in-kind contributions to the program (as listed
above) to be to the value of USD150,000 (exact breakdown to be discussed
together during ongoing program design discussions);
• In addition, Meta may provide ad credit coupons valued at USD30,000 to be
shared to Love Frankie to help promote the materials used together for the
program;
• We will further explore the plan to disburse USD70,000 excluding taxes to Love
Frankie in 2022, for the coordination, program development, and monitoring and
evaluation of the program;

• We will further explore the plan to renew this program in 2023-2024, subject to
future agreements where necessary and as agreed by all partners.
2. I will be in touch to discuss in more detail this prospective collaboration.
If you have input or have any questions, we will be happy to discuss further.
We thank you very much for your attention and cooperation.
Dessy Sukendar
Policy Programs Manager
Meta
